integrity: The numerical-abscissa formula, sign threshold, exponent monotonicity, and sharp prefactor-one decay statement were reconstructed analytically. The focal source was checked at its semigroup example and endpoint computations. Numerical evaluation was supplementary only and not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to constant planar upper-triangular shears with positive diagonal decay rates and induced finite-p norms.
Does not classify larger matrices, weighted norms, time-dependent coefficients, or bounds with prefactors greater than one.
An older equivalent computation under logarithmic-norm, matrix-measure, dissipativity, or contraction terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact \(L^p\) contractivity phase diagram for planar triangular shears
